Questions worth asking

FAQ

Is the FLOW Experience refundable?

No. The $99 FLOW Experience is a one-time digital education and community-access purchase and is non-refundable, except where applicable law requires otherwise. Please purchase only when you are ready to participate and evaluate the opportunity.

Is the $99 the cost of becoming an Enagic distributor?

No. The $99 is the one-time FLOW educational experience described on this page. Becoming an independent distributor is a separate decision and follows Enagic's official registration, product options and terms.

Am I guaranteed to make money?

No. Earnings are not guaranteed. Distributor income comes from product sales and varies based on sales activity, skill, effort, expenses and other factors. FLOW does not promise a specific income level.

Do I have to knock on doors?

No. FLOW focuses on education, relationships, content, referrals and modern systems. You still have to find and serve customers and make product sales; the training is about doing that without pressure-based tactics.

Is this recruiting people for commissions?

Enagic states that its compensation is product-focused and commissions are based on product sales, not recruitment. We'll teach the official business model and how to build within those rules.

Does “automation” mean I never have to work?

No. Systems can automate repetitive pieces of a business, but customer service, sales activity, learning and business stewardship still require human work.
